rules.seats_note: 391 in constituencies and 69 from national lists
rules.formula: constituency seats by largest remainder (Hare–Niemeyer); national-list seats by modified Sainte-Laguë (divisors 1.4, 3, 5, …)
rules.threshold_national_list: seats in at least 5 constituencies or 5% of the national vote
rules.minority_exemption: a minority committee could register a national list without lists in 5 constituencies (art. 76(3))
